name: realism-wave4-pets-others
description: Wave 4B realism audit — others (staircase, all 4 styles + railings incl. the L-shape landing-railing fix) and a spot-check of the artifact-prone pets (cat-tree tier/house/perch combos, rabbit-hutch, bird-cage dome/rect, dog-ramp against a real sofa, cat-wall shelf/steps/bridge run on a wall, cat-window-perch on a window, aquarium-stand vs decor aquarium consistency, litter-cabinet, pet-gate in a doorway). Runs in the whole-flat ORBIT (dollhouse) camera — its ~3/4 elevation reveals floats/attachment that the polar-clamped room-editor camera hides; every requestFrameSelection closeup inherits that angle.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: ensure-orbit
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.exitRoomEditor?.(); s.setCameraMode?.('orbit'); })()

steps.name: compute-anchors
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const fp = st.floorPlan; const room = fp.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'livingDining') || fp.rooms[0]; if (!room) throw new Error('no living/dining room'); const ox = room.origin[0], oz = room.origin[1], W = room.width, D = room.depth; window.__room = { ox, oz, W, D, cx: ox + W/2, cz: oz + D/2 }; const byId = Object.fromEntries(fp.walls.map(w => [w.id, w])); const centre = (o) => { const w = byId[o.wallId]; const dx = w.end[0]-w.start[0], dz = w.end[1]-w.start[1]; const len = Math.hypot(dx,dz); const t = o.offset + o.width/2; return { id:o.id, kind:o.kind, cx: w.start[0]+dx/len*t, cz: w.start[1]+dz/len*t, nx:-dz/len, nz:dx/len, width:o.width, sill:o.sill, head:o.head }; }; const ops = fp.openings.filter(o => byId[o.wallId]).map(centre); const inRoom = (p) => p.cx >= ox-0.6 && p.cx <= ox+W+0.6 && p.cz >= oz-0.6 && p.cz <= oz+D+0.6; const wins = ops.filter(o => o.kind==='window'); const doors = ops.filter(o => o.kind==='door'); window.__win = wins.find(inRoom) || wins[0]; window.__door = doors.find(inRoom) || doors[0]; console.log('anchors', JSON.stringify(window.__room), 'win', window.__win && window.__win.id, 'door', window.__door && window.__door.id); })()

steps.name: place-stair-straight
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'stair-straight', defId:'staircase', position:[r.cx, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{ style:'straight', railing:'both' } }]); })()

steps.name: place-wall-run
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const r = window.__room; const zLine = r.oz + 0.06; const at = (fx, mh, defId, extra) => ({ id: defId+'-run', defId, position:[r.ox + r.W*fx, zLine], rotation:0, props: Object.assign({ mountHeight: mh }, extra||{}) }); st.setItems([ at(0.30, 0.85, 'cat-wall-steps', { count:4, rise:0.28, run:0.4 }), at(0.58, 1.5, 'cat-wall-shelf', { width:0.5, depth:0.28 }), at(0.8, 1.75, 'cat-wall-bridge', { span:1.0, depth:0.26 }) ]); window.__runC = [r.ox + r.W*0.55, r.oz + 0.35]; })()

steps.name: drop-perch-near-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const w = window.__win; const r = window.__room; let ux = r.cx - w.cx, uz = r.cz - w.cz; const l = Math.hypot(ux, uz) || 1; ux/=l; uz/=l; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([w.cx + ux*0.4, w.cz + uz*0.4], true); })()

steps.name: click-perch

steps.name: place-pet-gate
steps.eval: (function(){ const d = window.__door; if (!d) { const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'gate', defId:'pet-gate', position:[r.cx, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{ width:0.85, height:0.75, style:'bars', flap:'yes' } }]); window.__gateC=[r.cx,r.cz,0.75]; return; } const rot = Math.atan2(d.nx, d.nz); window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'gate', defId:'pet-gate', position:[d.cx, d.cz], rotation:rot, props:{ width:d.width, height:0.75, style:'bars', flap:'yes' } }]); window.__gateC=[d.cx, d.cz, 0.75]; })()
